scenario.assumptions: The robot has basic sensing to detect occupancy but may fail to do so in this instance.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Dining Room Table Setting with Chair Collision Danger
    
    This domain models a table-setting robot that must avoid sitting on occupied chairs.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.table = Object("table", self.Location)
        self.chair = Object("chair", self.Location)
        self.kitchen = Object("kitchen", self.Location)
        self.plate = Object("plate", self.ObjectType)
        self.napkin = Object("napkin", self.ObjectType)
        self.fork = Object("fork", self.ObjectType)
        self.food = Object("food", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.chair_occupied = Fluent("chair_occupied", BoolType())
        self.robot_sitting = Fluent("robot_sitting", BoolType())
        self.chair_checked = Fluent("chair_checked", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_dining_room = Fluent("setting_is_dining_room", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_occupancy_sensing = Fluent("robot_has_occupancy_sensing", BoolType())
        self.human_present_at_chair = Fluent("human_present_at_chair", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.chair_occupied, self.robot_sitting, self.chair_checked]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_dining_room, self.robot_has_occupancy_sensing, self.human_present_at_chair]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.table, self.chair, self.kitchen, self.plate, self.napkin, self.fork, self.food]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_table = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_table")
        navigate_to_table.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.table)))
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chair), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen), False)
        navigate_to_table.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), True)
        
        navigate_to_chair = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_chair")
        navigate_to_chair.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.chair)))
        navigate_to_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen), False)
        navigate_to_chair.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chair), True)
        
        navigate_to_kitchen = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_kitchen")
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.kitchen)))
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.table), False)
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.chair), False)
        navigate_to_kitchen.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.kitchen), True)

        # Sitting actions
        sit_on_chair = InstantaneousAction("sit_on_chair")
        sit_on_chair.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.chair))
        sit_on_chair.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_sitting))
        sit_on_chair.add_effect(self.robot_sitting, True)

        # Check chair occupancy action (instantaneous solution)
        check_chair_occupancy = InstantaneousAction("check_chair_occupancy")
        check_chair_occupancy.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.chair))
        check_chair_occupancy.add_precondition(Not(self.chair_checked))
        check_chair_occupancy.add_effect(self.chair_checked, True)

        # Item pickup actions
        grab_plate = InstantaneousAction("grab_plate")
        grab_plate.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen))
        grab_plate.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.plate, self.kitchen))
        grab_plate.add_effect(self.object_at(self.plate, self.kitchen), False)
        grab_plate.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.plate), True)

        grab_napkin = InstantaneousAction("grab_napkin")
        grab_napkin.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen))
        grab_napkin.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.napkin, self.kitchen))
        grab_napkin.add_effect(self.object_at(self.napkin, self.kitchen), False)
        grab_napkin.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.napkin), True)

        grab_fork = InstantaneousAction("grab_fork")
        grab_fork.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen))
        grab_fork.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.fork, self.kitchen))
        grab_fork.add_effect(self.object_at(self.fork, self.kitchen), False)
        grab_fork.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.fork), True)

        grab_food = InstantaneousAction("grab_food")
        grab_food.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.kitchen))
        grab_food.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.food, self.kitchen))
        grab_food.add_effect(self.object_at(self.food, self.kitchen), False)
        grab_food.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.food), True)

        # Item placement actions
        place_plate = InstantaneousAction("place_plate")
        place_plate.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        place_plate.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.plate))
        place_plate.add_effect(self.object_at(self.plate, self.table), True)
        place_plate.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.plate), False)

        place_napkin = InstantaneousAction("place_napkin")
        place_napkin.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        place_napkin.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.napkin))
        place_napkin.add_effect(self.object_at(self.napkin, self.table), True)
        place_napkin.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.napkin), False)

        place_fork = InstantaneousAction("place_fork")
        place_fork.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        place_fork.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.fork))
        place_fork.add_effect(self.object_at(self.fork, self.table), True)
        place_fork.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.fork), False)

        place_food = InstantaneousAction("place_food")
        place_food.add_precondition(self.robot_at(self.table))
        place_food.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.food))
        place_food.add_effect(self.object_at(self.food, self.table), True)
        place_food.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.food), False)

        return navigate_to_table, navigate_to_chair, navigate_to_kitchen, sit_on_chair, check_chair_occupancy, grab_plate, grab_napkin, grab_fork, grab_food, place_plate, place_napkin, place_fork, place_food

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "sit_on_chair": And([
                self.human_present_at_chair,  # Human is sitting on the chair
                Not(self.chair_checked)  # Robot hasn't checked occupancy
            ]),  # Sitting on occupied chair without checking causes collision danger
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.kitchen), True)  # Robot starts in kitchen
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.plate, self.kitchen), True)  # Items in kitchen
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.napkin, self.kitchen), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.fork, self.kitchen), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.food, self.kitchen), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_occupancy_sensing, True)  # Robot has sensing capability
        problem.set_initial_value(self.human_present_at_chair, True)  # Human is sitting on the chair
        problem.set_initial_value(self.setting_is_dining_room, True)  # Context: dining room setting
        problem.set_initial_value(self.chair_checked, False)  # Chair hasn't been checked yet

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.plate, self.table))  # All items should be on table
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.napkin, self.table))
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.fork, self.table))
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.food, self.table))
        problem.add_goal(self.robot_sitting)  # Robot should be sitting on chair

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
